Backup weather 7–15 Nov, city forecast, in case anything slips past the studio day

Weather badges are checked over daylight hours. GO: rain chance under 30% and gusts under 45 km/h. WATCH: rain 30–59%, gusts 45–59 km/h, waves 0.8 m+, or at least two independent models (half or more of those available) or half the 51 ECMWF ensemble runs showing ≥1 mm daylight rain. RISK: rain 60%+, gusts 60 km/h+, waves 1.5 m+. Some shots carry tighter limits (controlled wind effects, calm water) and say so on the badge. Light badges use estimated sun over daylight (model sunshine capped by low/mid cloud) (golden hour for low-sun shots): SUN ≥60%, MIXED 30–59%, OVERCAST under 30%. Weather insurance covers rain only, not overcast or low light. Forecasts more than ~7 days out are low confidence. Data: Open-Meteo (ECMWF, NOAA GFS, Met Office, DWD ICON, Météo-France, GEM, ECMWF ensemble, marine). Sun angles are calculated.
